body.statement: The three-dimensional false-positive tuple passes singleton support matching and every local diagonal surgery check for an apparent empty DAG, but fails \(K_{c_0}=A^{\top}\Omega^{-1}A\); it therefore has no explanation in \(\mathcal M_3\).
body.justification: The example makes the baseline factorization check logically necessary for certificate soundness.
body.gap: The necessary rank screen in Squires et al. does not reject all tuples whose local differences mimic atomic interventions.
body.consumer: Certificate implementers receive a minimal false-positive test that catches omission of the global common-baseline constraint.
